intro.en: Custom relay and fuse-box harnesses connect protected power feeds, switching circuits and vehicle loads in a serviceable assembly.
intro.zh: 继电器与保险丝盒线束连接受保护馈线、开关控制回路与车辆负载，组成便于安装和维护的配电组件。

knowledge.en: Fuse selection, contact duty, conductor capacity, coil suppression and enclosure temperature must be coordinated.
knowledge.zh: 熔断器、触点任务、导体容量、线圈抑制与盒内温度需要协调设计。

notes.en: Provide the voltage, circuit diagram, load profile, connector details, mounting space and validation requirements.
notes.zh: 请提供电压、原理图、负载曲线、连接器资料、安装空间与验证要求。

delivery.en: Released drawings, material approval, sample validation and controlled assembly define each production version.
delivery.zh: 通过图纸放行、物料认可、样品验证与受控组装定义每个生产版本。

faq.zh: 继电器与保险丝盒线束常见问题

subtitle.en: Protected feeds, controlled loads and maintainable distribution
subtitle.zh: 受保护的馈线、可控的负载与可维护的配电

lead.en: A relay switches a load; a fuse interrupts specified overcurrent conditions. A complete harness connects both functions with power, trigger, return and output wiring. Builds range from a pre-wired relay socket and inline fuse holder to a multi-branch junction box with dedicated feeds, common busbars and option-specific connections. We develop the assembly around your equipment, circuit information and installation space.
lead.zh: 继电器负责接通和断开负载，熔断器在规定的过流条件下切断回路。完整线束把这两种功能与电源、触发、回流和输出导线连接起来。结构既可以是预接继电器插座与在线保险丝座，也可以是带独立馈线、公共母排和选装接口的多分支接线盒。我们根据设备、回路资料与安装空间开发适合项目的组件。

caption.en: Relay sockets determine terminal retention and service access.
caption.zh: 继电器插座关系到端子保持与维修可达性。

copy.en: Single-relay harnesses suit one controlled lamp, horn, pump or fan circuit. Dual-relay assemblies can separate two loads or operating modes; multi-relay fuse boxes organize several protected branches in one mounting location. Pre-terminated sockets, labeled outputs and defined mounting points simplify repeat installation. The assembly may include ring terminals, sealed connectors, inline fuse holders, a switch lead or an equipment-specific interface. Two relays do not automatically provide redundancy: a shared upstream fuse, feed or return remains a common failure point. Each branch therefore needs a documented purpose and protection path.
copy.zh: 单继电器线束适合独立灯具、喇叭、泵或风扇回路；双继电器组件可分开控制两组负载或工作模式；多继电器保险丝盒则把多个受保护分支组织在同一安装位置。预端接插座、输出标识与明确的安装点有助于重复装配。组件可以包含环形端子、密封连接器、在线保险丝座、开关引线或设备专用接口。两只继电器并不自动构成冗余，共用的上游保险丝、馈线或回流仍可能成为共同故障点，因此每个分支都需要明确的功能与保护路径。

caption.en: Stranded copper illustrates conductor construction, not an automotive material approval.
caption.zh: 多股铜线用于说明导体结构，不代表该示例线材已获得车用认可。

copy.en: Conductor area follows current, length, voltage drop, ambient temperature and bundling. Stranding supports flexibility, while the selected insulation grade must match heat, fluids and abrasion. PA or PBT housings, copper-alloy terminals, plating, seals and cavity plugs are reviewed as a matched system. The exact resin grade matters more than the polymer name alone. Split-loom tubing protects against mechanical contact but is not a watertight enclosure. A transparent relay cover does not establish switching capacity, and a ceramic socket does not remove the need to control terminal temperature. Material selection is recorded in the approved bill of materials.
copy.zh: 导体截面积应结合电流、长度、压降、环境温度与成束状态确定。多股结构有利于柔性，所选绝缘等级还需适应热、油液与磨损。PA 或 PBT 壳体、铜合金端子、镀层、线封与堵头需要作为配套系统审核，具体树脂牌号比聚合物名称本身更重要。开口波纹管提供机械防护，但不构成水密外壳。透明继电器盖不能证明开断能力，陶瓷插座也不能免除端子温升控制。最终用料应记录在批准的物料清单中。

caption.en: Mounted fuse positions illustrate branch organization and replacement access.
caption.zh: 保险丝安装位置对应分支组织与更换空间。

copy.en: Start with a load list that distinguishes continuous current, startup inrush, intermittent duty and abnormal conditions. Then coordinate the source feed, branch conductors, fuse characteristics, relay contacts and return path. Auxiliary-light kits may use the original lamp circuit only as a trigger, but that signal must first be checked for PWM, diagnostic pulses and controller limits. Cooling fans and pumps need an appropriate motor-load switching assessment. Winch or reversing-motor systems require a dedicated contactor and interlock review. We can develop a new assembly from released drawings or compare an existing sample with its circuit and equipment records before defining a replacement.
copy.zh: 先建立负载清单，区分持续电流、启动浪涌、间歇任务与异常状态，再协调能源端馈线、分支导体、熔断特性、继电器触点及回流路径。辅助灯套件可能仅把原车灯线作为触发信号，但必须先核对 PWM、诊断脉冲和控制器限制。冷却风扇与泵需要按电机负载评估开断任务；绞盘或换向电机系统则需要专用接触器与互锁审核。我们可以依据已放行图纸开发新组件，也可以结合回路和设备记录审核现有样品，再定义替换方案。

caption.en: Agricultural equipment introduces vibration, dust and field-service constraints.
caption.zh: 农业设备需要考虑振动、粉尘与现场维修条件。

copy.en: Passenger vehicles and commercial trucks use these assemblies for lighting, fans, pumps and body accessories. Agricultural and construction equipment add long routes, vibration, contamination and field repair. Emergency and specialist vehicles may require separated priority loads and defined backup-power boundaries. RV and custom-vehicle projects introduce parked loads, isolation and parasitic-current concerns. Marine projects require a separate review of salt exposure, installation location and applicable vessel requirements. These applications share a need for controlled distribution, but they do not share one universal fuse size, enclosure rating or wiring diagram.
copy.zh: 乘用车与商用卡车可用于照明、风扇、泵及车身附件供电；农业和工程设备还需考虑长路径、振动、污染与现场维修；应急及专用车辆可能需要分离关键负载并定义备用供电边界；房车与改装项目需要关注驻车负载、隔离和寄生电流；船用项目则另行审核盐雾、安装区域及适用船舶要求。这些应用都需要受控配电，但不共用一种通用保险丝规格、外壳等级或接线图。

caption.en: Electrical measurements support inspection; loaded tests require a defined fixture and method.
caption.zh: 电气测量用于辅助检验，受载试验还需明确夹具与方法。

copy.en: Verification begins with cavity-to-cavity continuity, polarity, isolation and relay operation against the released circuit. Loaded voltage-drop and temperature-rise checks reveal losses that a no-load continuity test cannot show. Insulation-resistance, dielectric, transient and environmental tests are specified for the actual assembly and customer requirements. Internal diodes, suppression devices or electronic modules may require isolation or different test connections. A test plan identifies operating conditions, sample configuration, instrumentation and acceptance limits. ISO 8820-2 provides automotive fuse-selection guidance; applicable fuse-family documents and component datasheets remain part of the project reference set. Listing a standard does not mean every assembly has passed its tests.
copy.zh: 验证从已放行回路对应的孔位导通、极性、隔离和继电器动作开始。受载压降与温升检查能够发现空载导通测试无法反映的损耗。绝缘电阻、耐压、瞬态和环境试验依据实际组件与客户要求规定；内部二极管、抑制器件或电子模块可能需要隔离或采用不同测试接法。试验计划应说明工作条件、样品配置、仪器与接收限值。ISO 8820-2 提供汽车熔断器选用指导，适用熔断器分册与元件数据表共同构成项目参考依据。列出标准不代表所有组件已经通过其中的试验。

caption.en: An installed fuse panel shows why access and identification belong in the layout.
caption.zh: 装车保险丝面板说明可达性与标识需要参与布局设计。

copy.en: A compact power-distribution module or junction box should shorten high-current paths while leaving room to remove fuses, open the lid, release terminals and use service tools. Busbar layout, cable exits, mounting orientation and branch bend allowances are established together. Dense packing also increases thermal interaction between adjacent devices; an open-air component rating cannot by itself demonstrate enclosed-box capacity. Spare cavities need defined plugs or approved terminals, and future options need a documented electrical budget. Compactness is useful when assembly, cooling and maintenance remain practical.
copy.zh: 紧凑的配电模块或接线盒应缩短大电流路径，同时保留保险丝拔取、盖板开启、端子退针和维修工具操作空间。母排布局、线束出口、安装方向与分支弯曲余量需要一起定义。高密度安装还会增强相邻器件间的热耦合，单个元件的开放空气额定值不能独立证明密闭盒内能力。备用孔位需要指定堵头或认可端子，后续选装回路需要明确电气余量。只有装配、散热与维护都可执行时，紧凑设计才真正有价值。

caption.en: A circuit-position label supports controlled assembly and later service.
caption.zh: 回路位置标识有助于受控装配与后续维修。

copy.en: Requirement review records the voltage, load profile, drawing, connectors, mounting and environment. Engineering then freezes the circuit table, BOM, branch dimensions, terminal orientation and inspection points. Samples are checked for fit, operation and agreed loaded conditions before the production version is released. Assembly controls cover cutting, stripping, crimping, terminal seating, seals, supports and labeling. Electrical inspection uses the approved circuit mapping; additional tests follow the order requirements. Delivery documentation can include the drawing revision, connection instructions, labels and agreed inspection records. Quantities, lead times and special validation are confirmed for each project.
copy.zh: 需求审核记录电压、负载曲线、图纸、连接器、安装与环境；工程阶段冻结回路表、BOM、分支尺寸、端子方向与检验点；样品完成装配适配、功能和约定受载条件检查后，再放行生产版本。组装控制覆盖下线、剥线、压接、端子就位、密封、支撑与标识。电气检查依据批准的回路映射执行，附加试验遵循订单要求。交付资料可以包括图纸版本、接线说明、标签与约定检验记录，数量、交期及特殊验证按项目确认。

caption.en: Rain represents exposure conditions, not a waterproof test of the product.
caption.zh: 雨景用于说明暴露环境，不表示产品已完成防水试验。

copy.en: Water resistance depends on the lid seal, wire seals, unused-cavity plugs, cable diameter and installed orientation. An IP claim applies only to a defined assembly and test condition. Vibration review includes relay retention, busbar support, connector locks and cable-exit strain. Heat soak and fluid exposure must be compatible with every material, including small seals and labels. Increasing contact resistance can create local heating even when current is below the fuse rating. Discoloration, loose terminals or repeated nuisance operation therefore call for fault investigation before a higher-rated fuse is considered.
copy.zh: 抗进水能力取决于盖板密封、线封、空孔堵头、线缆外径和安装方向，IP 声明仅适用于规定组件及测试条件。振动审核包括继电器保持、母排支撑、连接器锁止和导线出口受力。热浸及油液暴露需要与所有材料兼容，包括小型密封件与标签。即使电流低于保险丝额定值，接触电阻增大也可能造成局部发热。因此，出现变色、端子松动或反复异常熔断时，应先查明故障，再讨论是否调整保险丝规格。

title.zh: 熔断器类型与保护配合

caption.en: Fuse geometry, rating and holder compatibility must be checked together.
caption.zh: 熔断器结构、额定值与底座兼容性需要一起核对。

copy.en: Requests may specify ATO/ATC, MINI, low-profile MINI, MICRO2, MICRO3 or MAXI blade fuses, JCASE or MCASE cartridge formats, or MIDI and MEGA bolt-down types. These names identify different product families, not interchangeable approvals. Review the exact part number, rated voltage, interrupting capacity, time-current curve, pulse endurance and ambient-temperature derating. The fuse must coordinate with the conductor and fault-current source. A marked current rating is neither an instantaneous opening threshold nor permission to load the complete holder continuously at that value. Manufacturer data and the installed thermal condition govern the final selection.
copy.zh: 需求可能涉及 ATO/ATC、MINI、低矮型 MINI、MICRO2、MICRO3 或 MAXI 插片熔断器，JCASE、MCASE 盒式结构，以及 MIDI、MEGA 螺栓式类型。这些名称代表不同产品家族，不能视为可互换的认可。需要核对准确料号、额定电压、分断能力、时间电流曲线、脉冲耐受与环境温度降额，并使熔断器与导体及故障电流来源配合。标称电流既不是瞬时开断阈值，也不表示整个底座组件可以始终按该数值运行。最终选型以制造商资料及安装后的热条件为依据。

title.en: Relay Contacts, Coil Drive and Suppression

caption.en: Read the actual relay schematic and part number before assigning socket cavities.
caption.zh: 分配插座孔位前应核对实际继电器原理图与料号。

copy.en: Four-pin normally-open and five-pin changeover relays are common, but a second output terminal is not always a normally-closed contact. Mini ISO and micro relay packages also differ in terminal arrangement. Read the actual schematic, coil voltage, contact-load specification and suppression option before wiring the socket. Resistive, lamp, motor and capacitive loads impose different make and break duties. A diode across the coil introduces polarity and may delay release; resistor or other suppression choices must be coordinated with the driver and relay manufacturer. The printed contact current alone does not define switching life, enclosure temperature or total harness capacity.
copy.zh: 四脚常开与五脚转换继电器较常见，但第二个输出端不一定就是常闭触点；Mini ISO 与微型继电器封装的端子布置也可能不同。接线前应核对实际原理图、线圈电压、触点负载规格及抑制选项。电阻、灯具、电机和电容负载具有不同的接通与断开任务。线圈并联二极管会引入极性并可能延迟释放，电阻或其他抑制方式需要与驱动器及继电器制造商建议配合。壳体印刷的触点电流不能单独定义开关寿命、盒内温度或整套线束容量。

q.en: Can you build both a relay pigtail and a complete fuse-box harness?
q.zh: 能制作继电器尾线和完整保险丝盒线束吗？

a.en: Yes. The scope can include a pre-wired socket, fused single branch, dual-relay kit or multi-circuit distribution assembly. Drawings, load data, interfaces and installation requirements define the build.
a.zh: 可以，范围可包括预接插座、带熔断单路分支、双继电器套件或多回路配电组件，具体结构由图纸、负载资料、接口与安装要求定义。

q.en: Can the same assembly work on 12 V and 24 V?
q.zh: 同一组件可以同时用于 12 V 和 24 V 吗？

a.en: Only when every affected component and operating condition supports both systems. Relay coil voltage, suppression, fuse voltage rating, electronics and load behavior require explicit review.
a.zh: 只有相关元件与工况均支持两种系统时才可以，继电器线圈电压、抑制器件、熔断器额定电压、电子部件与负载行为都需明确审核。

q.en: Does a larger fuse solve repeated fuse failures?
q.zh: 反复烧保险丝可以直接换更大的吗？

a.en: Not without reviewing the fault, load, conductor and holder. A larger fuse can leave a smaller branch inadequately protected. Investigate shorts, overload, inrush, poor contact and thermal conditions first.
a.zh: 不能未经审核直接加大规格，更大保险丝可能使小线径分支保护不足。应先检查短路、过载、浪涌、接触不良和热条件。

q.zh: 所有五脚继电器都可以互换吗？

a.en: No. Contact arrangement, terminal assignment, coil voltage, suppression polarity, load ratings and package dimensions must match the released circuit and socket.
a.zh: 不能，触点形式、端子定义、线圈电压、抑制极性、负载额定值和外形尺寸都必须与放行回路及插座匹配。

q.en: What information is needed for a quotation?

a.en: Provide the system voltage, loads and duty cycles, schematic or sample, fuse and relay part numbers if specified, connectors, branch lengths, installation photographs, environment, labels, quantity and required tests.
a.zh: 请提供系统电压、负载与工作周期、原理图或样品、指定保险丝及继电器料号、连接器、分支长度、安装照片、环境、标签、数量和所需试验。
